The fix is in place, but I could not run any verification. Bash was denied in this session, so the tests, typecheck, and lint have not been run.

**Cause:** `ExecutionBaseError` set `this.name = this.constructor.name`. When `Error.prototype` is frozen, `name` is an inherited read-only property. An assignment to it throws a `TypeError` in strict mode, so constructing these errors fails. `WorkflowOperationError` and `SubworkflowOperationError` repeated the same assignment.

**Changes:**
- `src/errors/abstract/execution-base.error.ts`: replaced the assignment with `Object.defineProperty(this, 'name', …)`. I kept `enumerable: true` so the property matches what an assignment used to create.
- `src/errors/workflow-operation.error.ts` and `src/errors/subworkflow-operation.error.ts`: removed their `this.name = this.constructor.name` lines. The base constructor already sets the name from the concrete subclass, so these were redundant. `SubworkflowOperationError` still builds `cause.name` from `this.name`, which the base class now sets.
- `test/errors/frozen-error-prototype.test.ts` (new): freezes `Error.prototype` in `beforeAll` and checks that a custom `ExecutionBaseError` subclass, `WorkflowOperationError`, and `SubworkflowOperationError` construct with the correct `name`, message, level, description, and cause.

**Verification:** none run. I did not run `acdc-test`, `acdc-typecheck`, or `acdc-lint`, and I did not confirm the new test fails before the fix. The diff was reviewed with `git diff`.

evidence:
## fix(core): Construct execution errors correctly when Error.prototype is frozen

Constructing ExecutionBaseError subclasses threw when Error.prototype was frozen, because ExecutionBaseError assigned this.name, which is a read-only inherited property in that case. Replaced the assignment with Object.defineProperty (enumerable, writable, configurable as before), removed the redundant name assignments in WorkflowOperationError and SubworkflowOperationError, and added a test that freezes Error.prototype and checks the three error classes.

### What changed
- 3 source file(s), 1 test file(s), 45 changed lines
- `packages/workflow/src/errors/abstract/execution-base.error.ts`
- `packages/workflow/src/errors/subworkflow-operation.error.ts`
- `packages/workflow/src/errors/workflow-operation.error.ts`

### What ran
- The agent ran the tests 1 time(s) and says: Not run: Bash was denied in this session, so acdc-test, acdc-typecheck and acdc-lint were not executed. Changes were checked by reading the git diff only.
- Type check: passes; lint: not available for this commit
- Tests for the issue: 1/2; tests that passed before: 10/10

### Risks that remain
- Change risk: medium (14% chance of a revert or follow-up fix, from n8n's history)
- Tests, typecheck and lint have not been run; run acdc-test on packages/workflow/test/errors/frozen-error-prototype.test.ts and the existing error tests, plus acdc-typecheck and acdc-lint.
- The new test freezes the global Error.prototype in beforeAll; confirm it doesn't affect other tests in the same vitest worker.
- Other this.message assignments in node-api/node-operation/workflow-activation errors are unchanged; they only throw if the own message property is absent, which the Error constructor normally prevents, but a reviewer may want to check them.
- defineProperty uses enumerable: true to match the old assignment behaviour; confirm that toJSON/serialization output is unchanged.

judge.reason: The change fixes the `name` assignment in ExecutionBaseError, but WorkflowActivationError still does `error.constructor = cause.constructor; error.name = cause.name` on a fresh Error, which throws when Error.prototype is frozen. The same failure mode the issue describes remains when wrapping an ExecutionBaseError cause.
